findings.issue: ותשא is 3fs with כל־העדה as subject and no object in the clause; transitive alzó plus a postverbal NP can be read as an unnamed subject lifting the congregation.
ויבכו is qal 3mp with singular collective העם; Spanish singular lloró is agreement smoothing with el pueblo.

notes: Other tokens match person, stem, participants, and number, including 3mp dieron and singular קולם.
